report.title: Full GLM-5.3 NVFP4 - Corrected Hardware Capacity
report.subtitle: Graph-128 corrected TP8/MTP3 capacity across C1-C64 with three repetitions per operating point

model.quantization: ModelOpt NVFP4 W4A4 routed experts in layers 3-77; BF16 MTP layer 78

hardware.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96 GB

deployment.topology_display: one TP8 replica across eight GPUs; corrected CUDA graph capture through 128 tokens
deployment.cpu_numa_affinity: not explicitly pinned for this TP8 deployment

provenance_notes: This corrected capacity report uses graph-128 measurements only.
Three repetitions are included at every Decode and Prefill operating point; bands show the observed minimum-to-maximum range.
Fourteen prior graph-128 qualification measurements are imported by manifest reference as repetition one; repetitions two and three were executed in the formal campaign.
Graph 128 fixed the graph-64 MTP decode collapse at C32; the corrected deployment reached about 644 output tokens/s at C32 in qualification.
Graph-128 KV capacity was 568576 tokens, approximately 2.7 percent below graph 64.
GPU energy is estimated from sampled aggregate GPU board power and excludes non-GPU system power.
PCIe RX/TX metrics are aggregate GPU endpoint rates, not direct internal PCIe-switch port counters.
